description: Currency exchange rate and conversion read on chain from Chainlink FX feeds on Ethereum: EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, CAD, CNY, KRW, SGD, TRY, BRL, NZD, PHP, USD, gold (XAU) and silver (XAG); cross rates from two USD feeds. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: fx_rate
